name: Mugi
source:
A strange maid who always marches to the beat of her own drum. She is [url=/c167744]Hajime[/url]'s childhood friend and has served him for a long time. She always loves to eat until she's full, and, according to Mugi herself, she always burns off the excessive calories through cleaning her master's unnecessarily large mansion. She is nearly useless when it comes to maid-related activities other than cleaning and serving, to the point where one might even think "What are maids supposed to be like?" while looking at her.

She loves her master a lot, but doesn't act on her feelings because she's absolutely sure that he will pursue after her some day.

[From [url=https://asa-pro.com/ousama/character/]official website[/url]]
